notes.purpose: Keep the live runtime boundary separate from migration research and other repository-only material.
notes.update: When the live entrypoint, its modules, assets, or fetched data change, update runtimePaths/runtimeData and run node scripts/validate-ship-surface.mjs.
notes.archives: publishedArchives are frozen release links from index.html; they are published but are not dependencies of the current runtime surface.
notes.previews: The root preview pages are development experiments, not loaded or linked by the live entrypoint, so they are recorded as developmentOnly rather than shipped runtime paths.
